translations.web: Don’t hold the iniquities of our forefathers against us. Let your tender mercies speedily meet us, for we are in desperate need.
translations.bsb: Do not hold past sins against us; let Your compassion come quickly, for we are brought low.
translations.kjv: O remember not against us former iniquities: let thy tender mercies speedily prevent us: for we are brought very low.
translations.asv: Remember not against us the iniquities of our forefathers: Let thy tender mercies speedily meet us; For we are brought very low.
